svg.text: Anatomy of a Western Front trench system (3D cutaway)
Original illustrative diagram. Not to scale: depths are exaggerated about 4x so underground features are visible.
a short distance behind the front
zig-zag, so one shell or burst
rows of wire on iron pickets
often 100–300 m; in places under 50 m
a mirror image of our own
faces the enemy; parados at the rear
lit, with water and aid posts
